_doc: The Career League (#433): per format, the school decks a new League can start from (pick two; their cards join the collection and each becomes an editable League deck), the packs a start gives, and whether the format has a mixed pack drawing from all its sets. Wildcards come with the account's first League only. Rewards are in CareerLeague.
_packWildcards: The wildcard track: every League pack an account opens counts; every rareEvery-th adds a rare wildcard, every mythicEvery-th a mythic one instead. ProgressionBalanceTest checks the pace this gives.
